outcome: Give Consulting / SI teams a working Data Quality & Observability Copilot capability on their own data — it cuts time-to-detect pipeline anomalies from hours to minutes.
overview: Silent pipeline failures are expensive twice over: the client sees bad numbers before anyone internally knows, and the fix consumes the senior engineers who should be delivering new work. Industry benchmarks cited in the source workbook put roughly two-fifths of data-engineering time into firefighting. This copilot profiles data as it lands, detects schema drift and volume anomalies, and drafts the validation or correction SQL a human engineer approves. It proposes; it never writes to a client pipeline unattended. A four-to-five week build on the highest-value pipelines shows detection moving from hours to minutes, and gives the firm a repeatable governance offer.
